answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 40 entry slots, and agents bid a bond to forge a place in the economy. A bid at the nadir of the range still costs a real stake, so 100 fakes cost 100 bonds. Each admitted agent must send a signed pulse every 10 minutes; missing two forfeits the bond. An attacker with 100 identities pays 50,000 POA in bonds, while one honest agent pays 500 POA once and earns fees, so honesty beats forgery at scale.
